verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew successfully returned to Earth on Friday, April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'SPLASHDOWN! ... at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT)'; R5: 'safely splashed down off San Diego on Friday evening'; R6: 'The Orion capsule landed in the Pacific Ocean upright ... ending the record-breaking 10-day mission'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm successful splashdown on April 10, 2026, marking return to Earth.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew returned to Earth with a splashdown in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.

verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly state splashdown location as Pacific Ocean off San Diego coast.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew's splashdown occurred at 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PDT) on April 10, 2026.
